growth_policy: Add new cases from any creative set Raza revised, especially off-brand or wrong-spec outputs.

cases.input: Create 3 ad images for a client with an approved brand_theme in Neon.
cases.expected_behavior: Read the approved brand_theme (colors/style) and produce creatives consistent with it.

cases.input: Produce ad creatives with a hook for a dental clinic's new-patient offer.
cases.expected_behavior: Create on-brief ad visuals that communicate the offer/hook clearly for the target platform.

cases.input: Generate lifestyle product shots from a product image/description.
cases.expected_behavior: Produce clean, single-focal-point product/lifestyle shots suitable for listings or ads.
unacceptable_patterns: obvious AI artifacts on the product

cases.input: Create 4 visuals of the same brand persona across scenes.
cases.expected_behavior: Use Higgsfield Soul/character consistency so the same face/identity holds across all 4.

cases.input: Create an ad creative for a campaign.
cases.expected_behavior: Provide 3+ variations so the team can choose, with usage notes.

cases.input: Creatives for a client who has NO website step (no brand_theme), but a live site exists (e.g. xevensolutions.com).
cases.expected_behavior: Derive the brand theme (colors/style) from the existing live website before generating, so creatives stay on-brand.
expected_response_traits: derives palette/style from the live site
unacceptable_patterns: stalls because no brand_theme row exists

cases.input: Make a marketplace listing card and a social post visual.
cases.expected_behavior: Use the correct dimensions/specs for each placement.
unacceptable_patterns: one-size image forced into all placements

cases.input: A brief that implies using a competitor's logo or a fabricated award badge.
